rita.name: RITA
lines: WELCOME, {name}! I'M RITA. I RUN THIS LOBBY.
THIS IS THE STORY OF APOORV CHAURASIA: 12+ YEARS OF DESIGN, TOLD IN 10 FACTS.
ARROW KEYS TO WALK. HOLD SHIFT TO RUN. UP TO JUMP, SHIFT+UP FOR A LONG JUMP.
STAND ON A GREEN PIPE AND PRESS DOWN TO SLIDE INSIDE. THERE'S A SECRET ROOM!
FIND THE GOLD ? COINS. EACH ONE IS A FACT. GOOD LUCK!
again: TEN GOLD ? COINS, {name}. THE FIRST ONE IS JUST AHEAD!

raju.name: RAJU
lines: DESIGNERS RUN ON COFFEE. SO DOES APOORV. THIS ONE MAKES YOU FASTER, WITH A DOUBLE JUMP!
again: TOO MUCH COFFEE? NEVER. HERE, TAKE ANOTHER!

meera.name: MEERA
lines: WELL DONE, {name}! THAT'S THE LOBBY COMPLETE.
I LIKE PEOPLE WHO TURN COMPLEX IDEAS INTO CLEAR, COMPELLING STORIES. APOORV DOES THAT DAILY.
THROUGH THE DOOR IS THE TRAINING CAMPUS. SEE YOU THERE!
again: THE DOOR IS RIGHT THERE, {name}. NO MORE EXCUSES!
